name: Vasota Fort Jungle Trek
tagline: A boat crossing on Koyna Lake, then a Tiger Reserve jungle trek to ruined fort walls
seoTitle: Vasota Fort Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Vasota Fort inside Koyna Wildlife Sanctuary — mandatory forest permission, boat crossing, seasonal closure, and safety.

seasons.label: Nov – May
seasons.sub: The only season this trek is open — sanctuary closed in monsoon

seasons.label: Jun – Oct
seasons.sub: Closed — Koyna Wildlife Sanctuary shuts for tiger-reserve protection during monsoon

seasonNote: Vasota is a clear exception to the Sahyadri monsoon-is-best rule: the trek is officially closed June through October because it sits inside the Koyna Wildlife Sanctuary (part of the Sahyadri Tiger Reserve landscape), reopening after Diwali through end of May.

routeOptions.name: Boat + forest trail from Bamnoli
routeOptions.notes: Requires hiring a boat across Koyna Lake from Bamnoli (~₹2,000/boat — a group of 8+ makes this economical) before the forest trail to the fort ruins begins.

permits.name: Forest Department permission
permits.fullName: Mandatory prior permission at Bamnoli forest office
permits.notes: ID proof required; group must sign an indemnity bond. This is not optional — arrange before you travel.

safety.intro: Vasota's defining feature is bureaucratic, not physical: this trek requires advance Forest Department permission and only runs outside monsoon by law, since it sits inside a tiger reserve landscape.

alerts.title: Mandatory forest permission — arrange before you travel
alerts.body: You cannot simply show up and trek Vasota. ID proof and a signed indemnity bond are required at the Bamnoli forest office. Build this into your itinerary, not as an afterthought.

alerts.title: Closed June–October
alerts.body: The sanctuary shuts for the monsoon period to protect the tiger reserve. Plan your visit for the Nov–May window only.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Confirm the sanctuary is open for your travel dates (Nov–May window)
Bring photo ID — mandatory for the forest permission paperwork
Try to join or form a group of 8+ to make the boat cost economical

cards.title: On the trail
items: Bison/gaur sightings are reported — no tigers currently confirmed present per local operators, but stay alert and quiet in dense sections
Boat timing matters — confirm your return crossing time with the boatman before starting the trek

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: A local guide is effectively required/strongly recommended here given the sanctuary rules — factor the cost in
Coordinate with other trekkers at Bamnoli to share the boat cost if going alone

items.name: Life jacket (usually provided with the boat, confirm beforehand)
Cash in small denominations for the various sanctuary fees
